simple.meaning: to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve , till , (causatively) enslave , etc.
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָבַד (H5647) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 289 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עָבַד (ʻâbad) means to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve , till , (causatively) enslave , etc. First listed occurrence: 1Chr 19 19.
